rule: Agent owns film loop: selects from data/film-slate.json, refuses if no ready film or sources <5, invents only when >=5 credible free sources verified, fails loud never silent.
author: scripts/film/author.js writes ledger + 9/18-scene + audit + debate + title + sets spec + numeric audit
discover: scripts/film/discover-news.js pulls Wikipedia/Britannica; throws if <5 sentences
invent: scripts/film/invent-topic.js creates seed concept; throws if <5 sentences from free sources; validates consistency with invent-validator.js
validate: invent-validator.js passes only when all Q/A consistent (no broken invented Q/A)
relevance: current-affairs cards show high-yield / exam-relevant / low-priority from q.relevance; filter checkboxes in current-affairs.html
site: scripts/site/rebuild-films-page.js rebuilds films.html from film-slate.json; site-agent.yml runs it
pipeline: autopilot -> author -> build-film -> film.yml (QC/release) -> youtube-upload (manual until YOUTUBE_TOKEN added)
data: quiz-proper.json carries pubDate + relevance; film-slate.json carries pubDate + status; data/research/ holds agent-created briefs only
caution: AGENT CAUTION in every log; never invent without 5+ sources; never skip validation; never write manual briefs — agent creates from sources
budget: Zero paid APIs; rendering on GitHub Actions free runners; 720p previews on site; 1080 master release-only (Cloudflare 25 MiB cap)
evidence: Public dossier, sources list, sets spec, shot map, debate map, failed cuts, poster/master links visible
